subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
15. Urban Stay Realty decided to expand into Tier-2 cities after strategic
planning. The firm allocated budgets, assigned projects to motivated teams,
collaborated with local banks for financing, set up monitoring systems for
construction and marketing activities, and develop conducive culture. Within
two years, the company launched new housing projects successfully and
captured market share in new regions. Which stage of strategic management
does this case describe?
(A)  Environmental Scanning
(B)  Strategy Formulation
(C)  Strategy Implementation

8
(D)  Evaluation and Control
